subject: Insurance
title: The Climate Protection Gap
description: A quick win: understand The Climate Protection Gap.

hook.text: Only 40% of global climate losses are insured.

buildup.text: As climate change intensifies storms and floods, losses grow but insurance coverage doesn't keep pace.

discovery.text: The protection gap is worst in developing nations. In Africa, less than 3% of climate losses are insured.

twist.text: Insurers are retreating from high-risk areas.

climax.text: The protection gap is widening precisely when coverage matters most.

punchline.text: 60% of climate losses uninsured. The gap widens as the planet warms.

quiz.question: What percentage of global climate losses are currently uninsured?
